infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Vastrivo uses your location only when you choose to pin an address or share a delivery position.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Vastrivo uses the camera when you choose to add a profile, design, product, or delivery proof photo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Vastrivo accesses selected photos so you can upload profile, shop, design, and product images.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow Vastrivo to unlock your saved session.

plugins.photosPermission: Choose photos for your Vastrivo profile, shop, designs, and products.
plugins.cameraPermission: Take photos for your Vastrivo profile, shop, designs, and products.
